derivation: fun f g h => ext fun x => DFunLike.congr_fun (NonUnitalAlgHom.restrictScalars_injective R (congrArg (fun k : A →⋆ₙₐ[R] B => (k : A →ₙₐ[R] B)) h)) x
explanation: The candidate proves injectivity of scalar restriction for non-unital algebra homomorphisms. Coercing the equality of restricted star homomorphisms to underlying algebra homomorphisms lets that result recover equality of the original underlying homomorphisms; extensionality then gives equality of the star homomorphisms. The current proof uses pointwise extensionality directly.
